answer_1.quote: we design a user study where we seed users with an MMLU question and have them carry out a conversation with an LLM with the intent of answering that question.

answer_2.quote: we measure the correlation and mean absolute error (MAE) between simulator-AI vs. user-AI accuracies... measure the average BLEU and ROUGE scores of the simulator's first prompt

answer_3.quote: we use a separate LLM as an annotator to characterize the user-AI conversations... prompt a separate instance of GPT-4o to use this information to extract the answers to several classification questions

answer_4.quote: We recruited workers on Prolific to participate as users in our study... we paid all participants $5.00 upon completion of the entire task.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to answer questions correctly, incentivized with a bonus per correct answer, and provided feedback on task experience.
